title: Qualify cancellable exact pipeline boundaries, immutable per-step provenance and numerical budgets
commitMessage: feat: qualify exact pipeline cancellation and provenance boundaries

contribution.summary: Close M2-W02-C02 by demonstrating the existing 257-digit positive numerator budget defect with an independent behavioral RED, correcting magnitude validation, adding cooperative cancellation in shared direct/fluent evaluation and bounded immutable per-step exact quantity and dimension snapshots, and validating 10 independent boundary GREEN tests, prior pipeline and composition regressions, locked package, native plan and architecture.
contribution.value: Exact typed pipelines now retain bounded step-by-step numerical provenance, reject resource-boundary violations, and abort cooperatively without returning an invented or partial result; provider-neutral operation semantics and dimensional prevalidation remain intact.
debtChanges: M2-W02-C03 remains planned, so M2-W02 is in progress and no work-package achievement is claimed.
Cancellation checks are cooperative and do not forcibly preempt arbitrary blocking enumerators or an already running BigInteger operation.
Step snapshots describe local pure arithmetic only, not external provider execution telemetry, authorization or AURA host state.
No external AURA adoption, distributed scheduler, symbolic solver or provider execution is introduced.

RS035 retry 0 failed pre-attempt before allocation: the previously qualified T1 reflection test matched Evaluate only by name and became ambiguous after T2 added cancellation overloads; retry 1 selects the exact original method signatures and re-runs the full test suite.
contribution.nextAction: Prepare M2-W02-C03-T1 as a substantive independently falsifiable composition operation contract; preserve cancellation, exactness and provider separation without closing M2-W02 prematurely.

achievements.achievement: An independent compiled behavioral RED demonstrates that the existing pipeline wrongly accepts a positive 257-digit exact numerator against its advertised 256-digit budget.
The shared direct/fluent exact evaluator now refuses excessive positive and negative magnitudes, supports cooperative cancellation and captures immutable bounded local numerical step snapshots.
Ten adversarial T2 boundary GREEN tests plus T1, composition, IR, foundation, architecture and local locked NuGet packaging checks qualify the revised pipeline.
Resource, cancellation, exact per-step provenance and non-provider integration boundaries are qualified without external authority claims.
Both T1 exact direct/fluent contract and T2 operational boundaries are qualified; the C02 phase closes while M2-W02 remains in progress.
